value: SAME_LAB_AS (recall-oriented) = shared corresponding / senior author OR the same affiliation unit within +-N years; N = 3 (set by the signer 2026-10-26). lab_group_id is MANDATORY (status UNKNOWN allowed) for KIN and for DRV with a KIN parent; where authorship was not read, lab_group_status = UNKNOWN and the series is not SIM-VAL / DS-TEST eligible
rationale: AGENT DRAFT from review B #4. Steps 11 / 26 / 27 / 32 use the lab group as the unit of independence (CHG-11-3); the quotas and the VAL-5 group count cannot be computed unless authorship is stored (DOC.authorship). B0 descriptive group counts (39.0% / 39.4% shares) were known to the drafter; no lineage component, edge or label is computed.

quantity: Compilation membership screen status and the NOT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED label
value: per compilation source_family_id membership_screen_status in {BIBLIOGRAPHY_SCREENED, NOT_SCREENED, NOT_AVAILABLE}; when it is not BIBLIOGRAPHY_SCREENED, any train-on-compilation / test-on-primary evaluation (or the reverse) is labelled NOT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIED for cells that share (matrix family x analyte x process family) where the primary's year <= the release year
rationale: AGENT DRAFT from review B #3. USDA R6 and Bognar are compiled from primary papers that Steps 10-14 will acquire; 'no bibliography means implicit independence' is the wrong default for a recall-oriented design. Mirrors G08-9 (THR-08A-11). B0 descriptive group counts (39.0% / 39.4% shares) were known to the drafter; no lineage component, edge or label is computed.

quantity: K1 classifier label: number of distinct times at ONE temperature that earns the label K1 (k / order estimation); NOT a storage mandate
value: >= 3 distinct times at one temperature
rationale: AGENT DRAFT. SSOT 210.28 defines K1 only as 'multiple times at one temperature' with no number; 3 is the agent's reading (the smallest count above a before/after pair that includes the reference point). It labels, it does not decide whether a series is stored (that is THR-04K-01). No data seen.

quantity: Digitised series: independent reads required for TEST / SIM-VAL eligibility
value: two independent digitiser reads for any TEST / SIM-VAL eligible KIN built from a figure; inter-read SD stored in OBS.digitization.read_sd; single-read series stay TRAIN / CAL candidates
rationale: AGENT DRAFT from review B #16 (rule, no number beyond 2). Reproducibility and error propagation of a figure read need axis scale, calibration points, digitizer identity and repeat reads. No data seen.

quantity: Verification of the KIN mandate (R04-1)
value: the >= 2-numeric-time mandate is verified by the second extractor / adjudicator on the Step-09 dual-extraction sample, not by extractor self-report
rationale: AGENT DRAFT from review B #10(c): a rule enforced on the extractor's own tau count is self-certification. No data seen.
